Subject: RE: Order form indemnity — internal readout and suggested language

Marissa / Ben / Jonas — reading Tara's redlines now. High-level position and suggested options below. I'm keeping this internal for now; will prepare markup to share with Tara once we agree commercial trade-offs.

Issue 1: 30-day notice window
- Risk: very tight for complex third-party patent claims, especially cross-border evidence collection.
- Suggested compromise language (internal draft): "Customer shall provide Company written notice of any third-party claim within thirty (30) days of Customer's receipt of such claim, provided that failure to provide such notice within thirty (30) days shall not relieve Company of its obligations except to the extent Company is materially prejudiced by the delay."

Issue 2: OSS / pre-existing code carveout
- We can accept a mutual limited carveout for verified pre-existing OSS infringement claims where both parties can show provenance, but we should retain the right to pursue indemnity against parties that deliver infringing content as a service.
- Suggested: "Neither party shall be liable to the other for infringement claims arising solely from Open Source Software maintained in public repositories that were demonstrably used in Customer's instance prior to the Effective Date; provided that such use is documented and confirmed via the evidence checklist below."

Issue 3: Evidence checklist (operational) — propose to include as an appendix to the order form:
- copy of claim notice
- full sample output(s) alleged to infringe (with timestamps)
- any related prompt/context and user identifier (where available)
- confirmation of software versions / dataset provenance related to the allegation
- point of contact for follow-up, expected SLA for initial acknowledgement (48 hours)

Commercial trade: if the customer insists on 30-day strict notice and the OSS carveout, recommend Ben propose either: (a) 1% monthly credit for first three months post-execution if an asserted claim leads to remediation costs, or (b) add a shared escalation path with prioritized support + 10% discount on Dedicated onboarding fees.

I will draft the redline with the above language and an appendix. Marissa, if you want me to send the redline directly to Tara or route via you, let me know — I can hold until Ben confirms the commercial concession.

Kimberly

Tara — thanks for your patience. Quick summary of our proposed pathway so we can keep to your end-of-May timeline. Attached: consolidated redline (orderform_redlines_v3.docx) and an evidence checklist appendix.

What we propose:
- Notice window: Customer-provided notice within 30 days is acceptable, with standard prejudice carveout for delays (see clause excerpt in attached).
- OSS carveout: mutual limited carveout for documented pre-existing open-source components with a provenance check included in the evidence appendix.
- Evidence & operational SLA: please use the attached checklist when escalating a claim — we'll acknowledge within 48 hours and propose next steps within 7 business days.

Commercial trade to enable quick signature: Ben is proposing a one-time service credit equal to 1% of the first two months' committed spend if Greenfield accepts the mutual OSS carveout and the adjusted notice language. Our view is this is a narrow, constructive trade to keep the deal moving.

Next steps:
- Tara / Olivia: confirm whether the credit approach is acceptable and whether your procurement prefers the redline sent directly from Kimberly or via me as your account lead.
- If approved, we can get an updated order form back to you for signature within 3 business days.

Looking forward — we'll go as fast as you want on this.

Best,
Marissa
